independent_cases.case: Release-time finite recipient set; independent balances and movement
independent_cases.input: Representative authored reach R=2000000 data units, duration1000ms. At acceptance C(caster),A,L inside and B outside; before release B enters and L exits. At release C/A/B are eligible active player employees, one on Platform and the others on Ground. Enemy, Guest, summon/object and incapacitated controls are in range but ineligible. D enters only after release. Base200, typed Add40 and Scale+25%, then source generation+50%.
independent_cases.expected: Release atomically creates exactly C/A/B personal shields of450 each (total1350); none for L/D or ineligible controls. A takes incoming800 at50% mitigation: A50, B450, C450. B takes600 at50%: B150, A50, C450. A then takes200 at50%: absorbs50, losesHP50 and only A shield ends. Moving B out/in or moving C does not change B150 or its original expiry. D never gets a shield without a new cast.
independent_cases.witness: Per-recipient UnitInstanceId, distinct personal activation records, initial/remaining/expiry/source and actual ordered DamageFact/HP deltas. Capture acceptance and release positions to exclude acceptance-time selection. Other actors do not take unrelated hits.

independent_cases.case: One selected recipient, authored enhancement, typed-before-source and source once
independent_cases.input: Independent Normal single fixture replaces base with420, Add20, Scale+25%; Corrupt single replaces base with620, Add20, Scale+25%. Both then use source generation+50% exactly once. Select eligible A manually; keep C/B also in range. Recipients carry a differing generation modifier/stat through whatever supported successor mechanism implements the policy.
independent_cases.expected: Normal=(420+20)*1.25*1.5=825; Corrupt=(620+20)*1.25*1.5=1200. Only selected A gets one shield. Same amounts with one or three eligible allies; no N multiplication or recipient re-amplification. For incoming1600 then100 at50% mitigation: Normal825→25→0 with HP losses0,25; Corrupt1200→400→350 with HP losses0,0. Area450 is (200+40)*1.25*1.5; applying source first would yield425, so that order is distinguishable.
independent_cases.controls: Self selection is legal for Porccubus; enemy/out-of-reach/ineligible selection rejects without cost/new grant. Omitting an authored single enhancement must not silently introduce2S/4S. Exact missing-field default/rejection shape awaits successor schema; no numeric fallback is authorized.

independent_cases.case: Personal priority, creation-order ties and unchanged generic shared stage
independent_cases.input: One target has personal H70 priority9; personal E30 priority5 created before Porccubus P450 priority5; personal L20 priority-1; generic R12 shared Q100 priority99. Each has a distinguishable original provider/effect. Incoming1400,50% mitigation.
independent_cases.expected: Mitigated700 is absorbed in order H70,E30,P450,L20,Q100; HP loss30. All personal precede Q despite its higher priority. Equal-priority E precedes P by creation order. Other recipient shields and other-provider records are never merged into these balances.
independent_cases.cost_heal_controls: In a separate nondepleted P450 fixture, actual nonlethal HP cost10 takesHP100→90 and leaves450; normal heal10 restoresHP100 and leaves450. Elapsed time before expiry never raises remaining. Test Rest only through a supported path: if it is outside battle, verify ended battle-local shields cannot be resurrected/refilled by Rest/Continue. Do not invent an in-battle Rest API or use explicit RechargeShield as the no-recharge oracle.

independent_cases.case: Same-source whole-set recast, unrelated sources and atomic failure
independent_cases.input: At t0 source key K=(caster combat identity C, original fragment/equipment copy F, original effect G) grants C/A/B450 for1000ms. Consume A to50 and B to150. At t300 B is outside, D newly inside, C/A still inside. Recast K with unchanged amount450/duration1000. Independent shields from another provider, another original copy and another original effect also exist.
independent_cases.expected_success: One atomic replacement removes all old K records, including B outside the new range, and installs exactly C/A/D450 expiring at1300. A becomes450, never500; B has no K shield; unrelated keys remain byte/value-equivalent. Old expiry at1000 cannot terminate new K records. New cast does not aggregate old residuals.
independent_cases.expected_failure: Cancel before release or force late admission/fault after some candidate recipients are prepared: old K C450/A50/B150, unrelated shields, resonance/HP costs, RNG/ID, queue/action state and save roots remain as before the failed operation according to existing transaction semantics. No partial old removal or new grant. Retry with the admitted limit yields the exact successful set. Initial grant failure similarly publishes zero partial recipients.
independent_cases.witness: Complete old/new provider-key→recipient set and per-record expiry/remaining, committed cast identity/cost, before/after public roots plus internal candidate/RNG/ID/retained checks. A new late multi-recipient-grant/replacement fault seam is required; old single shield absorption failure alone is insufficient.

independent_cases.case: Recipient/source lifetime and nonchannel post-release CC
independent_cases.input: Independent C/A/B shields from one source plus another provider's shield on B. Exercise each target depletion, authored expiry, withdrawal/incapacitation/death, redeployment, source withdrawal/incapacitation/death and battle terminal independently. Apply HardCC and Silence after personal shield release while all identities remain active.
independent_cases.expected: A invalidation ends only A's original-identity shield; B/C remain. Redeployed A receives nothing from the old cast. Source C invalidation ends every grant provided by C, leaving other-provider protection intact until its own conditions; battle terminal clears all battle-local shields. HardCC/Silence alone after release does not cancel already-created nonchannel shields. Ordinary attack/block capability is not suppressed by a fabricated channel; existing CC restrictions themselves still apply. Fetus remains a separate channel control with its unchanged range-out/rejoin and interruption behavior.
